feed_summary: View CSAF Summary ROS# before version 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker that is able to pass a crafted message definition file to the user to inject arbitrary code into the generated program. Siemens has released a new version for ROS# and recommends to update to the latest version. The following versions of Siemens ROS# are affected: ROS# vers:intdot/<2.3.1 (CVE-2026-109097) CVSS Vendor Equipment v3 8.2 Siemens ROS# 1 Vulnerability Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') Background Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: Germany Vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109097 Affected systems do not properly escape text of message definition files.
